content: निपुण {%a.%} .²1 Clever, sharp, shrewd, skilful; वयस्य निसर्गनिपुणाः स्त्रियः <ls>M. 3</ls>. .²2 Proficient or skilled in, conversant or familiar with (with <ab>loc.</ab> or <ab>instr.</ab>); वाचि निपुणः; वाचा निपुणः. .²3 Experienced. .²4 Kindly or friendly towards. .²5 Acute, fine, delicate, minute, sharp. .²6 Complete, perfect, accurate. .²7 Absolute; प्रसन्ननिपुणेन <ls>Bhāg. 5. 4. 5</ls>. .{@-णम्@} Skill, proficiency; न चास्य कश्चिन्निपुणेन धातुरवैति जन्तुः कुमनीष ऊतीः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 3. 37</ls>. .{@-णम्@} {%ind.%} or निपुणेन .²1 Skilfully, cleverly. .²2 Perfectly, completely, totally, .²3 Exactly, carefully, accurately, minutely; निपुणमन्विष्यन्नुपलब्धवान् <ls>Dk. 59</ls>; निपुणमनुपाल्या हि शिशवः <ls>Mv. 5. 14</ls>. .²4 In a delicate manner.
